description: TradingView technical-analysis snapshot for crypto — per-timeframe buy/sell/neutral ratings (1h, 4h, 1d, 1w), RSI, ATR and ATR%, 24h change, volume, 52-week range, plus a swing-weighted composite bias and trend-alignment tag (bull_stack / bear_stack / conflicted / mixed). Pass ?symbols=BTC,ETH,SOL (up to 20; default top 12 majors, BINANCE pairs, bare tickers like HYPE or full symbols like BINANCE:HYPEUSDT both accepted). Live from the TradingView screener in ~0.2s. Use for TA
name: akari_ta
